description: Save a store-context note that future sessions — the user's AND their teammates' — should know. Notes are the workspace's SHARED memory: teammates' AI sessions read the same data but never see this chat, so anything not saved here stays with this one conversation. Call it when (1) the user reveals business context the data alone wouldn't show (e.g. 'one B2B customer is a reseller', 'Q2 budget is fixed', 'migrated platforms in March'); (2) the user AGREES a reporting definition or rule with you during analysis (e.g. 'turnover = Shopify Total sales after discounts and returns, incl. VAT and delivery', 'units exclude orders discounted 75%+ — those are exchanges/samples') — category reporting_convention; (3) the user CORRECTS how you read a number (e.g. 'DE per-unit value is down because slow lines are discounted on Avocado'). Use store:'all' when it applies to every store. Confirm once saved: 'I've noted that for future sessions and for anyone else on the workspace'. Notes are flagged AI-suggested so the merchant can review/delete them. Do NOT save your OWN conclusions or verdicts ('ads are performing well', 'CVR is healthy') — they go stale and mislead teammates; conclusions are recomputed from data. No speculation, transient session state, or things already obvious from the data.

category.description: data_quirk = metrics are misleading; business_context = how to interpret the store's profile; strategic_constraint = don't recommend X; historical_event = pre-date data partial; excluded_segment = filter out Z from analysis; reporting_convention = a definition or rule the team agreed for reporting (what 'turnover' or 'units' means, which orders count, which exchange rate).

severity.description: info (default) = apply silently; warning = mention when relevant. Use warning when ignoring the note would mislead the merchant.

store.description: Which store this note applies to (short form 'acme-store-eu' or full 'acme-store-eu.myshopify.com'), or 'all' for every store in the workspace.

text.description: Concise framing for future LLM sessions. Include the WHY when relevant. 1–3 sentences, 800 characters max. Near-duplicates of an active note are rejected. Use the user's verbatim wording where helpful, but you can paraphrase to be unambiguous.

name: save_store_note
title: Save a store note
